To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a cw, singly resonantly pumped, periodically poled lithium-niobate OPO with a 93% pump-depletion efficiency, which results in an 86% conversion efficiency and a 3.5 W idler output power at 3.3 microm.

we have developed two cw, singly-resonant optical parametric oscillators based on periodically pooled lithium niobate, that result in higher efficiency and output powers than previously demonstrated, and we have demonstrated >1 W of cw output over a 3.3 to 3.9-mum spectral range.
we have demonstrated two cw, singly-resonant OPO configurations that result in significantly greater efficiency and output power compared to previous studies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of efficient cw OPOs based on PPLN.
developing high-power, high-efficiency, tunable, cw optical parametric oscillators (OPOs).
the development of high-efficiency, high-power, tunable mid-infrared lasers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have demonstrated a 3.5 W cw singly resonant OPO with a 93% pump conversion efficiency and >1 W of idler output over 3.3 to 3.9 microm.
we have developed a novel OPO configuration that is capable of delivering >3 W of tunable idler output power with 80% quantum-limited efficiency.
we have achieved a new record in cw, single-resonant, singly resonant OPO performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have achieved the best performance to date for a cw OPO, with the highest efficiency, output power, and spectral bandwidth.
the singly resonant OPO configuration is the best way to achieve high efficiency and high output power.
we have achieved the highest efficiency and output power from a cw singly resonant OPO based on periodically pooled lithium niobate.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of an OPO cavity with an intracavity etalon, which has been shown to be a very effective technique for increasing the efficiency of singly resonant OPOs, can also be used in conjunction with the four-mirror cavity to achieve even higher efficiencies and output powers.
the use of a four-mirror configuration, which allows the idler output to be collected in a single beam, results in a significantly higher conversion efficiency.
the singly resonant OPO is a promising candidate for high-power, tunable, mid-infrared sources.
